description:
Creates a new custom content in the given space, page, blogpost or other custom content.

Only one of `spaceId`, `pageId`, `blogPostId`, or `customContentId` is required in the request body.
**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the content of the page or blogpost and its corresponding space. Permission to create custom content in the space.

201.description: Returned if the requested custom content is created successfully.

base.description: Base url of the Confluence site.

location.description: Relative link to created custom content Example response header format: `location: </wiki/api/v2/custom-content/<id>>`

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description: Returned if the type of custom content is not found.
